newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat closes higher on commercial support.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat closes higher on commercial support.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed higher on commercial buying but the market faded from the day's highs on late hedge selling, traders said.
"There was some commercial support until the late going, there was pre-hedge selling late," a trader said.
Traders said the late pre-hedging was in anticipation of a stepped up harvest Thursday.
KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed 1/2 to five cents per bushel higher, with July up 3/4 at $3.40-1/4.
KCBT wheat futures volume was estimated at 62.350 million bushels, above the 59.510 million bushels traded Tuesday.
